name: Check out Button
description: A compact trigger button that morphs into a checkout card with tabbed payment methods (QR, card, Apple Pay, Amazon Pay) and a connect-wallet screen, all sharing one layout shell.

variations.name: default
variations.previewHint: Click the button to expand the checkout card, switch payment tabs, then open Connect Wallet

featureSections.title: Button-to-Card Shell Morph
featureSections.summary: A shared layoutId projects the collapsed trigger and the expanded card as one element, so opening reads as a single object growing rather than a swap.
points: Shares layoutId across both states inside AnimatePresence mode="popLayout"
Expands on a spring with a slight 0.05 bounce, collapses ~20% faster with no bounce
Morphs border-radius from 10 to 20 as the shell grows
Fades and unblurs card content with layout="position" so it never distorts during projection

featureSections.title: Auto-Sizing Body & Method Panels
featureSections.summary: The card body springs to the measured height of the active step while each payment panel crossfades in place.
points: Measures layout height with react-use-measure offsetSize to ignore the open-morph scale
Gates the height tween until onLayoutAnimationComplete fires to avoid a double animation
Swaps panels via AnimatePresence popLayout with a scale-plus-blur enter/exit
Glides the active tab pill and the pay button between positions through layoutId shared transitions

featureSections.title: Pay ↔ Connect-Wallet Transition
featureSections.summary: Switching to the wallet screen keeps the primary action continuous by morphing one button into another via a shared layoutId.
points: Morphs the outlined Connect Wallet CTA into the filled Create a New Wallet pill, animating border-radius 12 → 9999
Remembers the previous payment step so Back returns to the exact tab
Keeps the payment chrome mounted across method changes, remounting only on the pay/wallet screen switch

featureSections.title: Accessibility & Reduced Motion
featureSections.summary: Interactive controls carry labels and pressed state, and all motion collapses when the user prefers reduced motion.
points: Labels icon buttons and method tabs with aria-label and reflects selection via aria-pressed
Exposes the collapsed trigger as role="button" and gives the QR image descriptive alt text
Respects prefers-reduced-motion by dropping every transition to duration 0 and using auto height
